subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should recovery be diagnostics-only, an explicit backed-up repair command, or automatic startup quarantine for bad Telegram/session state?
rationale: The choice affects user session continuity, whether runtime load paths may move state files, and where the plugin/core boundary for state repair should live.

options.title: Diagnostics plus explicit repair
options.body: Status or doctor should flag the bad artifact and an explicit repair should back up or quarantine it before rebuilding state.

options.title: Automatic startup quarantine
options.body: The gateway would self-heal when it detects unusable state, but users may be surprised by moved state and partial continuity loss.

options.title: Fold into generic session-store recovery
options.body: Keep Telegram messaging minimal and wait for generic session-store recovery to land, accepting that Telegram-specific operator guidance remains thinner.

recommendation.title: Diagnostics plus explicit repair
recommendation.body: Status or doctor should flag the bad artifact and an explicit repair should back up or quarantine it before rebuilding state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work spans both Telegram status/doctor seams and session-store loader behavior, which are the likely decision boundaries for this issue.
